newsitem.title: USA: LPC-Charter Communications taps banks for $365 mln.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Charter Communications taps banks for $365 mln.

text.p: NEW YORK, Jan 8 (LPC) - Toronto-Dominion and Credit Lyonnais are syndicating a $365 million loan for Charter Communications International Inc's acquisition of cable properties in North and South Carolina, according to banking sources.

The credit facility, which refinances a $205 million deal put in place by the banks last March, is split between a $190 million revolving portion and a $100 million term loan, both of which run 8.5 years, lenders said.
Additionally, a $75 million, nine-year term loan is offered to banks and institutional investors, lenders said.
The deal being refinanced was split between a $165 million, eight-year revolver and a $40 million, 8.5-year term loan, a banker said.
Pricing on the new loan is lower than that on the earlier loan, the banker added.
